retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
RAG POISONING

DESCRIPTION:
Attackers manipulate or inject malicious information into Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge bases, causing AI systems to retrieve and generate inaccurate, malicious, or misleading responses.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- Emerging AI Threat

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected AI responses
- Malicious documents in vector database
- Knowledge base tampering
- False information generation
- Unauthorized document updates

DETECTION RULES:
- Sudden content changes
- Unauthorized document ingestion

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Vector databases
- Knowledge repositories
- RAG applications
title: RAG POISONING
